Afterward, we added independent egress paths, cached common responses, and tested the service without its central identity endpoint. We didn’t chase perfect multi-cloud redundancy; that would have stretched our small team too far. Instead, we focused on reducing the blast radius and writing down exactly what should happen when a dependency disappears.
